title_en: Villa for sale near Te Farke Lake!
description_en: Villa for sale near Te Farke Lake! The villa is of an individual typology with details as below: -Plot: 330 m2 -Floor-1:76.7 m2 -Ground floor: 76.7 m2 -First floor: 76.7 m2 -TOTAL: 230 m2 - The basement serves as a technical area, laundry and games areas or can be used as a parking lot. - The ground floor is organized in the living room, kitchen and toilet. - On the second floor there are 3 bedrooms, a master bedroom and two children's rooms, which have a shared toilet in the corridor. A solar panel is mounted on the terrace, which will increase energy savings and provide independence from the national grid in case of emergency. It has a perfect location with direct access to the big ring road. Parking post for two vehicles at the entrance of the villa. Price €385,000
